# Contributing to ChemBFN project

### Before creating an issue
* If it is related to the training behaviour (e.g., oscillating loss, nan value), please check your hyperparameter settings.
* If it is related to the testing metrics (e.g., very small or negative R<sup>2</sup> values, no available ROC-AUC), please check your data quality and/or distribution difference between training data and testing data.

### Feature request?
Please make sure you understand our papers before suggesting a feature.

### AI code policy
No AI generated code is allowed.
